thread:
anya: quick results from the 8h run comparing flashv2 / flashv3 / triton-vendor across H100 & A100 in us-west1 + eu-west1. put a short table below, asking: when do we flip default to flashv3?

kevin: nice, can you paste the aggregated p50/p95 and mem numbers?

anya: sure — aggregated over 1M requests, mixed seq lengths (32/128/1024). small table:
```
model | gpu  | kernel     | p50(ms) | p95(ms) | mem(GB) | q8 perf delta
llama-2-13b | H100 | flashv2   | 12.1    | 45.8    | 5.2     | baseline
llama-2-13b | H100 | flashv3   | 10.3    | 49.2    | 5.4     | -3% latency avg, +7% p95
llama-2-13b | H100 | triton    | 13.0    | 46.0    | 6.0     | -1% latency
llama-2-13b | A100 | flashv3   | 11.8    | 44.0    | 5.9     | -2% latency
llama-2-13b | A100 | triton    | 11.6    | 42.9    | 6.1     | baseline
```
notes: flashv3 gives better median but higher p95 on H100 in eu-west1 due to a weird kernel-path that triggers on sequences <64.

rajiv: saw that too in our local repro — short sequences cause extra kernel fallback which serializes some threads. Triton vendor kernel is more consistent on short seqs on A100.

sara: also flagging that q8 quantization paired with flashv3 had slightly higher next-token perplexity on our codegen eval set (delta +0.6 ppl) — not huge but noticeable for dev-facing apps.

devon: My recommendation: don't flip org-wide default yet. Do a region- and length-aware routing policy: flashv3 for seq>=128 on H100, triton for seq<128 or A100. Canary rollout to 5% then 25% with automatic fallback on errors/timeouts.

anya: agree on rollout. proposal for kernel_selector config:
```
kernel_selector:
  - if: gpu == H100 and seq_len >= 128
    kernel: flashv3
  - if: gpu == H100 and seq_len < 128
    kernel: triton
  - if: gpu == A100
    kernel: triton
  - fallback: flashv2
```

kevin: can we add a quick Prometheus alert for p95 spike > 2x baseline and a metric for "kernel_fallback_rate" so SRE can auto-roll back?

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline: canary job queued: pipelines/rollout-kernel-selector-1889 (eta ~ 12m) :gear:

bench-bot: uploaded full raw traces + flamegraphs -> https://internal.gists/runs/1889012345 (includes per-region breakdown, cold-start vs steady-state)

rajiv: re: eu-west1 H100 issue — I can try a micropatch to avoid the fallback for seq 32/48 by forcing a contiguous KV layout; should shave the p95. putting a patch up for review.

sara: and I'll re-run the codegen eval on the q8 flashv3 path with our larger prompt set (10k prompts) — will report regressions by EOD.

devon: if we keep fallback thresholds conservative we should be safe. also propose adding a small A/B comparison with quality metrics (not just latency) during the canary so we detect those codegen ppl diffs.

anya: good plan. I'll open the rollout PR with config and monitoring playbook. thanks all :thumbsup:

kevin: add me as approver on the PR. if eu-west1 p95 doesn't improve after rajiv's patch, we should consider pinning flashv3 off in that region until upstream kernel fix.

anya: noted. tracking in PR + created incident if p95 crosses threshold.

bench-bot: benchmark summary: H100 long-seq (>=1024) flashv3 wins p50 by 15%, cost per token -8%. short-seq (<64) flashv3 p95 regresses in eu-west by ~7%.

devon: TL;DR: hybrid selector + canary + quality gating.

anya: leaving follow-ups in the PR. 👍
